''Carroceiros'' (Wagoners) | founded = {{start date and age|18 September 1942}} | ground = [[Estádio da Tapadinha|Tapadinha]] | capacity = 4,000 | chairman = Ricardo Delgado | manager = Pedro D’Oliveira | league = [[Liga 3 (Portugal)|Liga 3]] | season = [[2024–25 Liga 3 (Portugal)|2024–25]] | position = [[Liga 3 (Portugal)]], Promotion group (8th) | pattern_la1 = _thinyellowborder | pattern_b1 = _3navystripes | pattern_ra1 = _thinyellowborder | pattern_sh1 = _yellow_stripes | pattern_so1 = _yellowline | leftarm1 = 142753 | body1 = FECD39 | rightarm1 = 142753 | shorts1 = 142753 | socks1 = 142753 | pattern_la2 = _thinblueborder | pattern_b2 = _collarblue | pattern_ra2 = _thinblueborder | pattern_sh2 = _blue_stripes | pattern_so2 = _navyline | leftarm2 = FEFEFE | body2 = FECD39 | rightarm2 = FEFEFE | shorts2 = FECD39 | socks2 = FECD39 | pattern_la3 = _goldborder | pattern_b3 = _goldcollar | pattern_ra3 = _goldborder | pattern_sh3 = _gold_stripes | pattern_so3 = _yellowline | leftarm3 = 273992 | body3 = 273992 | rightarm3 = 273992 | shorts3 = 273992 | socks3 = FEFEFE }} '''Atlético Clube de Portugal''' is a Portuguese sports club based in the parish of [[Alcântara, Lisbon|Alcântara]], in the west side of [[Lisbon]]. The club was established on 18 September 1942 through the merger of two local clubs from Alcântara: [[Carcavelinhos Football Club]] and [[União Foot-Ball Lisboa]]. In addition to football, the club has sections for [[futsal]] and [[basketball]]. Historically, it also had sections for [[field hockey]], [[swimming (sport)|swimming]], [[sport fishing]], [[cycling]], [[table tennis]], [[rugby union|rugby]], [[volleyball]], [[gymnastics]], [[triathlon]], and [[handball]]."}}
